newsitem.title: USA: Walgreen declares two-for-one stock split.
newsitem.headline: Walgreen declares two-for-one stock split.

text.p: Walgreen Co, the drugstore chain, said Wednesday its board of directors declared a two-for-one stock split.
The split will be distributed August 8 to shareholders of record July 22, the company said.
The board also declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.06 a share, payable September 12 to shareholders of record August 21, the company said.
Without the stock split, the dividend would have been $0.12 a share, unchanged from the previous quarter.
Walgreen shares were up one at 57-3/4 Wednesday.
